column1: # Photon OS ISO permutation matrix - the executable form of ISO-PERMUTATION-MATRIX.md
# Columns
#   id          stable identifier; also the VM name and the last IP octet offset
#   iso_type    minimal | full          BUILD-TIME axis -> selects/creates an ISO
#   poi         2.8 | latest            BUILD-TIME axis -> selects/creates an ISO
#   stig        no | yes                INSTALL-TIME
#   fs          ext4 | btrfs            INSTALL-TIME
#   mode        ui | ks                 INSTALL-TIME (the fifth dimension)
#   ks_variant  -                       ks only: none|selinux|fips|stigpkgs
#   canister    prebuilt | build          BUILD-TIME axis -> selects/creates an ISO.
#               x86_64 default is fips=1 + canister_usage=1, i.e. the kernel links
#               against the PREBUILT linux-fips-canister RPM from the Broadcom repo.
#               'build' compiles the canister locally and emits the subpackage.
#               acvp/kat are certification builds that force other flags; they prove
#               something about certification tooling, not about a PR, so they are
#               deliberately not rows here. mc-build-iso.sh still accepts them.
#   doc         the verdict ISO-PERMUTATION-MATRIX.md records (pre-PR)
#   expect      what mission control expects WITH all PRs applied
# doc vs expect is the whole point: where they differ, the PRs are doing work,
# and a run that matches doc instead of expect is a PR regression.
# On mode=ks + stig=yes: the STIG menu is UI-only (stigenable.py is reached
# only from the curses configurator), so a kickstart cannot "answer yes". The
# ks rows express STIG by listing KS_STIG_PACKAGES manually - which is what
# ks_variant=stigpkgs does. This is a genuinely different code path, not a
# duplicate of the UI row.
#id      iso_type  poi     stig  fs     mode  ks_variant  doc        expect  canister
p01      minimal   2.8     no    ext4   ui    -           works      pass   prebuilt
p02      minimal   2.8     no    btrfs  ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p03      minimal   2.8     yes   ext4   ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p04      minimal   2.8     yes   btrfs  ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p05      minimal   latest  no    ext4   ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p06      minimal   latest  no    btrfs  ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p07      minimal   latest  yes   ext4   ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p08      minimal   latest  yes   btrfs  ui    -           fails      pass   prebuilt
p09      full      2.8     no    ext4   ui    -           works      pass   prebuilt
p10      full      2.8     no    btrfs  ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p11      full      2.8     yes   ext4   ui    -           works      pass   prebuilt
p12      full      2.8     yes   btrfs  ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p13      full      latest  no    ext4   ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p14      full      latest  no    btrfs  ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p15      full      latest  yes   ext4   ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
p16      full      latest  yes   btrfs  ui    -           untested   pass   prebuilt
k01      minimal   2.8     no    ext4   ks    none        works      pass   prebuilt
k02      minimal   2.8     no    btrfs  ks    none        untested   pass   prebuilt
k03      minimal   2.8     yes   ext4   ks    stigpkgs    fails      pass   prebuilt
k04      minimal   2.8     yes   btrfs  ks    stigpkgs    fails      pass   prebuilt
k05      minimal   latest  no    ext4   ks    none        fails      pass   prebuilt
k06      minimal   latest  no    btrfs  ks    none        fails      pass   prebuilt
k07      minimal   latest  yes   ext4   ks    stigpkgs    fails      pass   prebuilt
k08      minimal   latest  yes   btrfs  ks    stigpkgs    fails      pass   prebuilt
k09      full      2.8     no    ext4   ks    none        untested   pass   prebuilt
k10      full      2.8     no    btrfs  ks    none        untested   pass   prebuilt
k11      full      2.8     yes   ext4   ks    stigpkgs    untested   pass   prebuilt
k12      full      2.8     yes   btrfs  ks    stigpkgs    untested   pass   prebuilt
k13      full      latest  no    ext4   ks    none        untested   pass   prebuilt
k14      full      latest  no    btrfs  ks    none        untested   pass   prebuilt
k15      full      latest  yes   ext4   ks    stigpkgs    untested   pass   prebuilt
k16      full      latest  yes   btrfs  ks    stigpkgs    untested   pass   prebuilt
# Kickstart-only failure class (section 11.3). These have NO UI counterpart:
# the security: key is synthesised for everyone on POI latest, but on 2.8 it
# is only present if the kickstart author writes it. fips is never appended on
# the UI path on either version, so s02 is reachable exclusively via kickstart.
s01      minimal   2.8     no    ext4   ks    selinux     fails      pass   prebuilt
s02      minimal   2.8     no    ext4   ks    fips        fails      pass   prebuilt
# Canister axis. c01 is the only row that exercises a locally BUILT canister,
# which is the code path PR #1673 (shared canister_config.inc) touches - nothing
# else in this matrix executes it. c02 needs aarch64 hardware: fips=0 is the
# aarch64 default and is not reachable on x86_64, so it stays UNRUNNABLE here
# rather than being quietly dropped.
c01      full      2.8     no    ext4   ks    none        untested   pass    build
c02      full      2.8     no    ext4   ks    none        untested   pass    fips0-aarch64
